To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified a key residue in the bHLH monomers that determines which bHLH dimer will bind a particular E-box sequence.
we used a structural and logis systems approach to infer the DNA binding determinats of a set of Caenorhabditid bHLH transcription factors.
we used protein binding microarrays and logics to infer bHLHLH DNA binding specificities and that we identified a critical residue in bHLH that determines the half-site that each monomer binds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of DNA binding determinants in paralogous TF proteins.
the problem of understanding gene regulatory networks.
the molecular determinants that dictate DNA binding specificity of paralogous transcription factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this paper provides a detailed and systematic approach for determining bHLH–E-box half-site specificities, and that the results of this study provide a blueprint for system-wide approaches in other organisms.
the bHLH monomers can be divided into two groups, one group that can bind to the E-box and the other group that can bind the non-E-box.
the bHLH–E-box half-site interaction is a highly conserved and critical interaction that dictates the DNA binding specificity of the bHLH family of transcription factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DNA binding determinations for 19 C. elegans bHLH dimmers have been made using protein binding microarray (PBM).
a structural and logico-computational approach can be used to infer DNA-binding specificity determinants for bHLH dimmers and other paralogous TF dimers.
the DNA binding determinates are highly variable between different bHLH proteins.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a structural and logico-computational approach can be used to infer bHLh–DNA binding specificity.
the structural and logics system can be used to infer the DNA binding specificity determinants of TFs.
a combination of experimental and computational approaches can be used to identify the determinants of TF–DNA binding specificity.
